WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Get 2–4 AI-picked winning products every day
• Spy on the real Facebook ads running for each product
• Visit the live competitor store selling it
• Source instantly with direct AliExpress, Alibaba, Amazon and eBay links
• Run the numbers with a built-in profit calculator

AI WINNING PRODUCTS

Browse by niche, sort by newest, and filter by date to zero in on the right product. Every product shows its price, cost and margin at a glance, so you understand the opportunity before you commit.

FACEBOOK AD SPY

COMPETITOR STORE SPY

INSTANT SOURCING
Every product comes with direct links to suppliers on AliExpress, Alibaba, Amazon and eBay. Check pricing, compare shipping and order samples in seconds — sourcing that used to take hours now takes a tap.

PROFIT CALCULATOR
Know your numbers before you risk a dollar. Plug in your product cost, selling price, fees and funnel rates to instantly see break-even and target ROAS, cost per purchase, cost per add-to-cart and more.

Whether you dropship on Shopify, TikTok Shop or your own store, Dropshipping+ gives you the winning products, ad intelligence and profit tools to grow your dropshipping business. Download Dropshipping+ and find your next winning product today.

Premium unlocks every supplier and competitor link plus the latest daily finds.

record.name: Know-It: AI Shopping Assistant
record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Know-it.ai: Your Ultimate AI Shopping Assistant
Introduction: Welcome to Know-it.ai, a revolutionary AI-powered shopping assistant designed to transform your shopping experience. Whether you're searching for the best deals, comparing prices, or checking for allergens in food and cosmetics, Know-it.ai is the ultimate tool for all your shopping needs.
Core Features:
1. Ingredient Analysis:Know-it.ai utilizes advanced AI algorithms to analyze the ingredients of various products, focusing on food and cosmetics. This feature is invaluable for health-conscious consumers, those with allergies, or anyone curious about product ingredients. The app cross-references a comprehensive database to identify common allergens, health benefits, and potential risks associated with these ingredients.
2. Allergen Identification:The app excels at recognizing common allergens in both food and cosmetic products, such as nuts, gluten, dairy, and harmful chemicals or irritants. Customize your profile based on your specific allergies, and receive alerts if a scanned product contains any ingredients you should avoid.
3. Health Benefits Assessment:Know-it.ai highlights the positive aspects of ingredients, such as vitamins in food products or beneficial compounds in skincare items. This helps users make informed and healthier lifestyle choices.
4. Potential Health Impact:In addition to allergens and benefits, the app provides insights into the long-term health impacts of regular use of certain ingredients, including carcinogens and food additives.
5. Customization and Alerts:Tailor the app based on your specific health concerns and dietary preferences. Know-it.ai alerts you when a scanned product contains ingredients you should avoid and suggests healthier alternatives.
6. Educational Content:Know-it.ai offers educational content about ingredients, including their origins, common uses, and why certain ingredients are considered harmful or beneficial. This empowers you to make informed decisions.
Technical Implementation:
- AI and Machine Learning: Know-it.ai leverages Natural Language Processing (NLP) to provide personalized recommendations based on user preferences.- Database Management: A robust database stores comprehensive information about ingredients, including their properties, associated health benefits, and risks.- User Interface: The intuitive and user-friendly interface allows users to easily scan or input product information and view detailed analysis.- Customization Algorithms: Personalize your experience based on your allergies and health preferences.
Market Impact and User Benefits:
Know-it.ai empowers consumers with vital information about the products they use daily, promoting health-conscious decisions, preventing allergic reactions, and educating users about product safety and benefits.

FourTip — Honest feedback before you buy

Not sure if something is worth buying?
Worried you’ll overspend, buy on impulse, or regret it later?

FourTip helps you make better purchase decisions before you spend.

Take a photo of an item or upload a screenshot, and get a discussion from 4 distinct AI personalities with different perspectives on your potential purchase. Instead of one generic answer, FourTip gives you a more useful conversation: value, usefulness, alternatives, overpaying, long-term satisfaction, and whether you actually need it.

Why people use FourTip

Buying decisions are rarely just about price. Sometimes you need help answering questions like:

* Is this actually worth the money?
* Will I really use it, or just like the idea of it?
* Am I buying this because it’s useful — or because it feels exciting right now?
* Is there a better option I haven’t considered?
* Am I about to make another purchase I’ll regret later?

FourTip is designed to help with exactly that.

What makes FourTip different

Most advice is too soft, too generic, or too biased:

* friends don’t want to offend you,
* sellers want you to buy,
* reviews are noisy and contradictory,
* and your own brain isn’t always trustworthy in the middle of a tempting purchase.

FourTip gives you 4 different perspectives instead of one bland opinion.

Each personality looks at the purchase in a different way:

* practical value,
* emotional appeal,
* logic and trade-offs,
* personal motivation and long-term satisfaction.

That means you don’t just get “buy it” or “skip it.”
You get a conversation that helps you see what you may be missing.

Use FourTip to

* Get honest feedback before buying
* Challenge impulse purchases
* Compare options and alternatives
* Think through expensive or uncertain purchases
* Spot overpaying and poor value
* Decide with more confidence
* Learn from your own buying patterns over time

Key features

4 honest perspectives

Get a discussion from four distinct personalities instead of one generic AI answer.

Should I Buy This?

Upload an item and get an instant debate around whether it’s worth buying.

Alternative suggestions

Sometimes the best outcome isn’t “buy” or “don’t buy” — it’s discovering a better option you didn’t think of.

Follow-up after purchase

Check back later and track whether a purchase actually turned out to be worth it.

Learn your own decision patterns

Over time, FourTip can help you notice which opinions you trust, where you tend to overspend, and what leads to good or bad purchases.

Who FourTip is for

FourTip is for anyone who:

* tends to second-guess purchases,
* makes impulse buys,
* wants honest feedback before spending,
* enjoys comparing options,
* or simply wants to make smarter decisions with money.

Whether it’s sneakers, clothes, home items, gadgets, decor, or random things you suddenly want — FourTip helps you slow down, think clearly, and buy with more confidence.

Don’t buy alone.
Ask FourTip first.

record.description_evidence:
VideoShow - AI Video Editor & AI Video Generator helps you create stunning videos effortlessly. Transform your favorite moments into beautiful videos with photos, music, stickers, filters, and AI effects—making every memory unforgettable.

Key Features:
AI Video Generator: Turn photos or text into amazing AI-powered videos. Generate from photo to video, image to video, or text to video instantly. Create stylish story clips or viral effects with ease.

AI Smooth Movie: Upload 3-10 photos and let AI weave them into a seamless cinematic video. Smooth camera flights, zero edits, one click to share.

AI Text to Video Editing: Reimagine any short video with AI using a text prompt or reference image. Add or remove objects, transform backgrounds, weather, lighting, or style, and use AI green screen cutout and relighting to create a newly reimagined video with natural motion and effortless editing.

AI Video Editing: Choose your content and let AI automatically add effects, filters, transitions, and subtitles—crafting cinematic videos with visuals, voiceovers, and captions in one tap.

AI Text to Image: Turn your words into stunning AI-generated images. Describe your idea, and convert your creation into a photo with one tap.

AI Image Edit: Reimagine any photo with AI using simple text prompts. Replace content, transform styles, rewrite specific areas, or upload a reference image to guide the look and feel of your edit.

Trending AI Effects: Explore viral templates like AI Anime, AI Dance, and more! Create unique, eye-catching AI videos that stand out on TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook.

Now upgraded with HappyHorse 1.0 & Seedance 2.0 for Text-to-Video   & Image-to-Video — Generate higher-quality AI videos from text or photo with smoother motion, stronger visual storytelling, and more cinematic results.

Smart Video Editing: Merge, crop, split, reverse, copy, or rotate clips easily. Adjust video speed, zoom in/out, or blur backgrounds to focus attention.

Creative Elements: Enjoy 30+ filters, fun stickers, dynamic transitions, GIFs, and stylish text options. Access the best content center with themes, effects, stickers, emojis, and sound FX.

AI Cutout Tools: Instantly remove video or image backgrounds with AI-powered Video Cutout & Image Cutout, simplify editing and create professional-quality results.

Compress & Optimize: Reduce video size in seconds without losing quality. Export in 720P/1080P/4K HD—fast, clear, and smooth.

AI Music Generator: Transform text into unique music tracks with AI. Generate original melodies from your words for vlogs, short films, or storytelling.

AI Photo Enhancer: Bring photos to life with AI-powered upscaling and detail enhancement.

AI Colorizer: Turn old black & white photos into colorful, vibrant images using intelligent color restoration.

AI Object Removal: Perfect your videos or photos by removing unwanted objects instantly with precision AI.

AI Voice Changer: Change your voice to cute, mature, robotic, or funny tones—add personality and fun to your videos.

Music & Sound: Choose from hundreds of background tracks or import your own music to match your vibe.

VideoShow makes editing and AI generation easy, fun, and powerful—all in one app. Whether you want to edit, enhance, or create videos from text or photos, VideoShow turns imagination into stunning reality!

Unlock all premium features. Payment is charged to your iTunes account and renews automatically unless canceled 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in iTunes settings.
